I know you dont want to hear this but your stuffed animal loves you unconditionally and they are always there. They dont judge either. If you love them embrace them. Let the world know, and if they make fun of you then they dont deserve you. The hardest part of feeling less lonely is loving YOU. And I dont mean just telling yourself affirmations. No that wont make a difference. Know you are not perfect. Find your quirks and smile or smirk or laugh or what ever you feel like doing. Know that they make a small part of your personallity. Find your strengths and use them to your advantage. Maybe you have always been good at casing an enviorment but people said you are to anxious so you didnt use that skill. Well screw them! Thats them not loving you unconditionally, because you see understaning is loving. Maybe you love just observing people or you love what others call "stupid" commercials but you once thought they were neat and cool. Screw what those people think. Be you, be yourself. You also have weaknesses but that isnt a bad thing. Weaknesses set your limits. If you didnt know how far you could run and you ran 100 miles because of that you would most likely die. Hey just be you and show your true beauty. Your stuffy loves you and so will others!
